title: Temporary profile percentage for a duration set does not end.
symptom: Temporary profile percentage set to 80% for 180 minutes does not end; after 12 hours it is still active and shows negative time in overview. The pump history confirms it did not cancel.
cause: AAPS did not schedule 'KeepAlive', which happens sometimes on some phones due to Google's library, preventing the profile switch from being enacted.
fix: Restart of AAPS probably helps. The user may search logs for 'KeepAlive' to ensure it works.
evidence_quote: AAPS didn't schedule "KeepAlive". this is happening sometimes on some phones and as it's google's library I cannot affect it. Restart of AAPS probably helps.
